The '''Tynquay sector''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] star [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
In the decades leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it operated the [[Tynquay Sector Forces]]. The [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] officer [[Shoan Kilian/Legends|Shoan Kilian]] served in this unit for many years before becoming an [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].
